message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "---
# yamllint disable rule:comments rule:line-length rule:truthy
name: Lint

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: ["master"]
  push:
    branches: ["master"]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  hadolint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    name: hadolint
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Run linter
        uses: hadolint/hadolint-action@06be81baf89a55ffd0e24b8f04a4185738dd3387 # v3.5.0
        with:
          recursive: true
          config: .hadolint.yaml

  yamllint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    name: YAMLLint
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Run YAMLLint
        uses: frenck/action-yamllint@34b4bbcaeabedcfefad6adea8c5bbc42af0e2d47 # v1.5

  shellcheck:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    name: ShellCheck
    steps:
      - name: Check out the repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Run linter
        uses: ludeeus/action-shellcheck@00cae500b08a931fb5698e11e79bfbd38e612a38 # 2.0.0
        env:
          SHELLCHECK_OPTS: -e SC1008 -s bash -x
        with:
          # Names of scripts with custom shebangs that the action would not
          # discover on its own:
          additional_files: >-
            check_certificate_renewal
            discovery
            finish
            lock-tables-for-backup
            matter-server-discovery
            reboot
            run
            shutdown
            universal-silabs-flasher-up
            unlock-tables-for-backup
            vlc-discovery",
  "rationale": "The supported optimization is P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (bound jobs with a custom timeout), which is in scope for workflow_yaml and has a reviewed pattern with estimated benefit plus a measured_ci_workflow_on_fork experiment example showing a timeout bound reduced elapsed time. Prerequisites are met: the repository CI history shows representative successful runs (about 14 seconds, all success), so a 10-minute timeout gives ample operational headroom and will not interrupt valid slow runs, avoiding the contraindication. The change is minimal and preserves all intended build/test coverage: the same three lint jobs (hadolint, yamllint, shellcheck) still run on the same triggers with the same steps and permissions. It only replaces the default unbounded runner timeout with an explicit 10-minute bound per job, which bounds runaway consumption without adding secrets, network access, publishing/deployment, or weakened permissions.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508"]
}
